chunks: And it is narrated that al-Sindī ibn Shāhak said to Abī al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام:
I would like you to allow me to shroud you.
So he said: “Indeed, we are a House whose first hajj, the dowries of our women, and our shrouds are from the pure part of our wealth.”

key_terms.أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ: the People of the Household, referring to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.أُكَفِّنَكَ: to shroud you, meaning to provide your burial shroud
key_terms.اَلسِّنْدِيَّ: Al-Sindī, the named speaker in the report

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام say that the Ahl al-Bayt use their own pure wealth for shrouds and dowries?
ai.summary: This report relates that Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام declined the offer for his shroud to be provided by another person. He states that the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام use the pure part of their own wealth for major sacred obligations and family rights, including hajj, dowries, and shrouds.
